title: Wire lock contention to the lock_contended code
description: From the 2026-08-15 complete code audit: the code catalog defines `lock_contended` (src/core/result.ts:222, retryable: true) but nothing ever emits it. When `proper-lockfile.lock` in `withLedgerLock` (src/core/store.ts:306-310) exhausts its retries it throws a raw Error, which surfaces as `unexpected_error` (retryable: false) in CLI/MCP/dashboard. The intended retry guidance is dead. Fix: catch the lock-acquisition failure in `withLedgerLock` (or the surface error mappers) and emit `lock_contended`.
acceptance: A lock-contention timeout surfaces as a diagnostic with code `lock_contended` and `retryable: true` in all three surfaces (CLI, MCP, dashboard), not `unexpected_error`.
The fix does not mask genuine unexpected errors.
A test simulates lock contention (held lock + short/forced failure) and asserts the `lock_contended` code.
All checks green: `bun test`, `bun run typecheck`, `bun run check`, `waystation validate`.
notes: Reported as audit finding #3 (medium). Touches src/core/store.ts, which is also touched by task-sse-event-coverage and task-sweep-tmp-coverage; coordinate.
